description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the ST VL53L0X time of flight sensor, including initialization, configuration, measurement, and power management functions.

methods.name: vl53l0x_setup_single_shot
methods.description: Configures the VL53L0X sensor for a single measurement cycle.

methods.name: vl53l0x_start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the VL53L0X sensor.

methods.name: vl53l0x_init
methods.description: Zephyr device initialization function for the VL53L0X driver.

methods.name: vl53l0x_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a measurement sample from the sensor.

methods.name: vl53l0x_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves measurement data (distance or proximity) from the sensor.
